vision: Build an open-source, AI-native C++20 + Lua AAA open-world game engine that rivals and surpasses modern AAA engines (like RAGE / GTA VI) while continuously learning from every release, render inspection, and hardware telemetry run.

verifiedEngineeringLessons.lesson: Eliminate road/terrain Z-fighting by sinking buried collision slabs (visible=false), setting camera nearPlane >= 0.50m, layering road elevations cleanly, and sinking flat terrain grid cells 0.22m below flat road planes while skipping completely flat terrain quads.

CPU physics and GPU shaders must share exact analytical formulas: world.sampleWater() evaluates the exact same 4-wave displacement equation as kWaterVertexShader, and Jolt HeightFieldShape leaves water volumes as cNoCollisionValue so dynamic props sink cleanly to the seabed and float via Archimedes buoyancy.

Blender glTF 2.0 export evaluates the top-most (last created) NLA track as the resting bind pose. Always record the upright 'Idle' clip LAST and explicitly keyframe Hips location + rotation in every clip so horizontal poses like 'Swim' never bleed into standing poses.

Avoid Blender Metaballs for procedural characters (MetaElement capsule scale/quaternion quirks cause unpredictable spikes) and avoid loose disconnected tubes. Use clean manifold quad-topology Subdivision-Surface sculpting (bmesh anatomical lofting with seamless armhole/pelvis bridges), polar-aligned eyeballs recessed cleanly behind the brow, true linear PBR colors (sRGB^2.2), and visually verify multi-angle Cycles renders (front 3/4, head close-up, head side profile, walk & run poses) before exporting.

Always align Armature bone rolls predictably (align_roll((0,-1,0)) for limbs) and verify Foot bone dorsiflexion (+X toes up on heel-strike) vs plantarflexion (-X toes down on toe-off). Use periodic Catmull-Rom 8-phase gait curves with lateral hip weight-shift, pelvis/chest counter-rotation, and real-time bone-level TRS/quaternion slerp crossfade blending in C++ so transitions never snap.

Combine procedural FBM rolling hills & surrounding mountain ranges with an analytical road/plaza/lagoon flattening mask, auto-ground off-road scene models in SceneLoader so zero trees/buildings clip or float, mirror the heightmap into a Jolt HeightFieldShape, and sample 4 wheel contact points (FL/FR/RL/RR) for realistic AAA vehicle pitch, roll, and spring-damper suspension.
